title: Vanilla Chess
description: Resource pack that add vanilla style chess to Minecraft
body:
Vanilla Chess is a completely vanilla renaming-based resource pack that adds chess pieces.
![board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0043dac710176f110823e38ea3f85bd1c5fc00f9.png)
## How to use To get chess piece you need to rename **oak planks for white pieces,** and **spruce planks for black pieces,** in the table you can see names for each chess piece. | Oak Planks | Spruce Planks | Name | | :---: | :---: | :--- | | | | **King**| | | | **Queen**| | | | **Bishop**| | | | **Knight**| | | | **Rook**| | | | **Pawn**| ## How to proper setup your chessboard - White bishop and knight models by default position in item frame is always **facing South.** - Black bishop and knight models by default position in item frame is always **facing North.**
that was done to make them facing each other, but you can always just rotate all the item frames to change they facing direction.
